quests.instruction: TYPE AN ACADEMIC DESCRIPTION CONTAINING ALL BOOSTER TERMS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Prompt 1-1] Explain how organisms survive around deep geothermal springs without any solar radiation.
quests.sampleAnswer: Deep bacteria utilize rich hydrogen sulfide from venting springs to drive chemosynthesis.
quests.hint: Mention bacteria converting inorganic sulfur compounds into organic biological cellular energy. (Diving calibration index 1-1)
quests.explanation: Hydrothermal ecosystems run entirely on chemical conversion without any light support. [Verified by Academy Scribe Unit 1].

quests.instruction: TYPE AN ACADEMIC DESCRIPTION CONTAINING ALL BOOSTER TERMS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Prompt 1-2] Describe the ecological function of upwellings in cold deep-sea zones.
quests.sampleAnswer: Coastal winds displace surface currents, pulling cold nutrient water up to fuel plankton blooms.
quests.hint: Explain how displaced surface layers drag deep nitrates up to trigger biomass growth. (Diving calibration index 1-2)
quests.explanation: Upwelling currents act as nutrient elevators, igniting explosive plankton growth near sunlit zones. [Verified by Academy Scribe Unit 1].

quests.instruction: TYPE AN ACADEMIC DESCRIPTION CONTAINING ALL BOOSTER TERMS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Prompt 1-3] Explain the biological mechanism behind cold organic bioluminescence in deep creatures.
quests.sampleAnswer: Organisms oxidize chemical luciferin with oxygen to generate cold glow emissions in pitch darkness.
quests.hint: Focus on enzymatic oxidation releasing light energy without generating metabolic heat. (Diving calibration index 1-3)
quests.explanation: Biological lights are generated by oxidizing organic luciferin compounds under high deep pressure. [Verified by Academy Scribe Unit 1].

quests.instruction: TYPE AN ACADEMIC DESCRIPTION CONTAINING ALL BOOSTER TERMS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Prompt 2-1] Explain how giant kelp canopies construct functional floating ocean sanctuaries.
quests.sampleAnswer: Kelp plants anchor to bottom rocks, stretching to harness sunlight and build dense protective canopies.
quests.hint: Describe how large brown algae form architectural kelp forests that shelter diverse fish species. (Diving calibration index 2-1)
quests.explanation: Kelp plants anchor securely, growing rapidly upwards to compose floating forest systems. [Verified by Academy Scribe Unit 2].

quests.instruction: TYPE AN ACADEMIC DESCRIPTION CONTAINING ALL BOOSTER TERMS
quests.prompt: [Calibration Prompt 2-2] Explain why deep-sea bacteria are critical to abyssal biogeochemical cycles.
quests.sampleAnswer: Bacteria decompose sinking organic particles, recycling mineral compounds in the dark abyss.
quests.hint: Detail how deep microbes break down organic marine snow to enrich bottom currents. (Diving calibration index 2-2)
quests.explanation: Abyssal decomposition breaks down marine debris, returning rich elements back to ocean currents. [Verified by Academy Scribe Unit 2].
